youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each country slide to its real size 🌍 Did #4 get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: CIA World Factbook / UN Statistics Division (Greenland 2,166,086 km²; Australia 7,692,024; Russia 17,098,246; Africa ≈30.37 million; Sweden 450,295; Madagascar 587,041; DR Congo 2,344,858).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
youtube.comment: Greenland vs the Congo – did you get it? 🌍 Comment your score /4 👇

story.title: This Map Is Lying To You
story.hookLine: This map is lying to you. Which is really bigger?
story.question: Which is really bigger?

lines.a: Australia! More than three times the size.
Africa! Nearly twice as big as Russia.

lines.q: Last one. Greenland, or the Congo?
lines.a: The Congo! Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. So, how many did you get?
